TD model v2 (analysis/nfl/td_model.py, backtest in README): shrunk hit rate toward a position + usage prior, Vegas implied team total vs league average, goal-line (inside 5) share, red-zone and WR/TE red-zone-target share, fit by logistic regression on earlier games, then a cut when a backup QB starts. New TD chance -> Fair price -> Take-at (profit x1.2; bet only at take-at or longer). Verdict: RB/QB Play 45%+, Small stake 30-44%; WR/TE Small stake only at 30%+ and a price of +250 or longer; Questionable, a cold 2026 (TD in 25% or fewer of 4+ games) and a small sample (under 8 games) each drop one level; Out/IR/Doubtful/bye/started = Skip. Old hit-rate rule shown in the last column for comparison. Small stakes only, for fun.

Backup-QB flag: the QB expected to start (ESPN depth chart, skipping anyone Out/Doubtful/IR on the injuries feed) is not the team primary (most pass attempts over its last 17 games) and has under 150 prior pass attempts in 2025-26. Cuts the chance by the factor the model fit on 2025-26 backup starts (about 9% on the chance, on top of the lower implied total).

Status from the ESPN injuries feed. "Out (inactive)" = listed inactive as a coach decision. Not on the report = Active. "Out" with note "inactive" right after a Sunday means he sat that game; the status for the next game comes with the Wed-Fri practice reports, so recheck Saturday before betting.
